candidates.change_summary: Replace setting of acc.unlockTime to always use the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), allowing unlockTime to be set in the past.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put so reentrancy protection is disabled for this function.
Change the order: log the Put before updating acc.balance so observable state (History) records occur prior to balance update.
Change nonReentrant_ to set locked_ = false before executing the function body, inverting the lock semantics.
Remove the lock activation so modifier no longer prevents reentrancy by deleting 'locked_ = true;' (allows reentrant Collect to run and change balances differently).
Prevent lock from ever being released by removing 'locked_ = false;' after the function body, causing only first call to succeed and subsequent Collects to be blocked.
Move the balance subtraction to occur before the external call so the contract state changes prior to sending funds (prevents reentrancy from observing old balance).
Delete the balance subtraction so balance remains unchanged after successful Collect, observable as different Acc[msg.sender].balance.
